items.title: How to tell when your garage door needs service
items.excerpt: Noisy movement, uneven lifting and a door that will not open can all point to worn or damaged components.
items.body:
A garage door that becomes noisy, slow or uneven may need service before a small issue becomes a larger repair. Springs, cables, rollers and openers can all affect how safely and smoothly the door operates.

If a spring has broken or the door is stuck, avoid forcing it open and contact Acme Garage Doors for repair help in Niagara Region.
